select * from ( SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T1.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, T1.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, T1.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE capiIncomeFeature, T1.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, T2.TYPE_1 assetType, T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T1.ISSUE_AMT issueAmt, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T5.BASIS basis, T5.INT_TYPE intType, nvl(T8.YIELD, T5.RATE)*100 rate, T6.DATA_SOURCE dataSource, T1.UPDATE_USER updateUser, T1.UPDATE_TIME updateTime FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T3 ON T1.ISSUER = T3.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID
AND T4.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO T5 ON T5.CASH_ID = T4.CASH_ID AND T5.EFF_DATE = T1.VDATE left join (select FINPROD_ID, max(eff_date) as EFF_DATE from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE group by FINPROD_ID ) tempT8 on T1.FINPROD_ID = tempT8.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T8 ON T8.FINPROD_ID=tempT8.FINPROD_ID AND T8.EFF_DATE = tempT8.EFF_DATE and T8.CASH_ID = T4.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T6 ON T6.FINPROD_ID =T1.FINPROD_ID ) T
1=1 AND T.FINPRODTYPE IN('F07','F21')
AND (T.finprodMarketId like concat(concat('%',#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') or T.finprodName like concat(concat('%',#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
AND T.assetType = #{assetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T.VDATE >= TO_DATE(#{vdateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND T.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{vdateEnd},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND (T.MDATE >= TO_DATE(#{mdateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') or T.MDATE is null)
AND (T.MDATE <= TO_DATE(#{mdateEnd},'YYYY-MM-DD') or T.MDATE is null)
select COUNTER_ID code ,COUNTER_NAME name,COUNTER_NAME shortName,COUNTER_ID hidCode from MST_COUNTER_PARTY where COUNTER_TYPE = #{counterType}
SELECT CALENDAR_ID code,CALENDAR_NAME name,CALENDAR_NAME shortName,CALENDAR_ID hidCode FROM MST_CALENDAR_INFO where IS_TRADE_CALENDAR = #{isTradeCalendar}
SELECT count( * ) FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, case FINPROD_TYPE when #{FINPROD_TYPE_ZQ} then FINPROD_ABBR ELSE FINPROD_NAME end name, case FINPROD_TYPE when #{FINPROD_TYPE_ZQ} then FINPROD_ABBR ELSE FINPROD_NAME end shortName, FINPROD_MARKET_ID hidCode FROM FIN_PRODUCT
and (FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or FINPROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
AND FINPROD_TYPE in('F07','F21')
and PROFIT_TYPE = #{profitType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
